Rs 400/- per class/lecturer of 45 minutes; ceiling of maximum 50 classes with Rs. 20,000/- per month
Purely temporary, till closure of schools on summer vacation in 2027 or posting of PGT in the school, whichever is earlier
Offline – application to reach the Principal

content_sections.heading: About Govt. Higher Secondary School, Majhidhanua
content_sections.text: Govt. Higher Secondary School, Majhidhanua is a government higher secondary school in Kosagumuda Block of Nabarangpur district, Odisha, with +2 classes in the Arts Stream. This engagement of Guest Faculty is made pursuant to the Govt. in School & Mass Education Department Approved Letter No. 14101/SME Dtd. 01.06.2026, as communicated by the Director, Higher Secondary Education, Odisha vide letter No. 13112 Dtd. 03.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists the subjects offered in the Arts Stream for which Guest Faculty will be engaged. It does not print the number of posts for each subject.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Two groups are invited: Retired Teachers of Govt. and Aided College/HSS below 65 years of age, and Fresh Eligible Candidates. The notice states that in case of non-availability of such teachers, fresh candidates will be selected. Candidates should check the official notification for the subject-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.qualification: Master Degree in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks or equivalent grade and B.Ed. or equivalent degree recognized by the NCTE New Delhi, in case of B.Ed. subject.
rows.experience: Teaching experience and basic experience in computer application are assessed in selection.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Retired Teachers of Govt. and Aided College/HSS must be below 65 years of age. The age limit for fresh eligible candidates is not specified in the notice, and no age relaxation is printed.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely temporary in nature, for the session 2026-27. It will continue till closure of schools on summer vacation in 2027 or posting of PGT in the school, whichever is earlier. The Principal reserves the right of disengagement by giving one month notice if performance is not satisfactory.

rows.pay: Rs 400/- per class/lecturer of 45 minutes duration, subject to a ceiling of maximum 50 classes with Rs. 20,000/- per month

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection shall be made through career assessment (printed as "carrier assessment"), teaching experience and basic experience in computer application, followed by document verification. Career assessment: the candidate's academic record. Teaching experience: supported by the experience certificate. Basic experience in computer application: supported by the Certificate of Computer Knowledge. Document verification: on 12.11.2026 in the office of the Principal, Govt. Higher Secondary School, Majhidhanua. No TA/DA shall be admissible for document verification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Govt HSS Majhidhanua Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are offline and should reach the undersigned (the Principal) at Office of the Principal, Govt. Higher Secondary School, Majhidhanua, Block- Kosagumuda, Dist- Nabarangpur on or before 10.11.2026. The notice does not mention whether the application is to be sent by post or handed in. The details can be obtained from https://nabarangpur.odisha.gov.in .

rows.event: Last date for application to reach

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Self-attested documents to be attached with the application form: Bio-Data duly filled up. HSC or Equivalent Certificate and Mark sheet. +2 or Equivalent Certificate and Mark sheet. Bachelor Degree or Equivalent Certificate and Mark sheet. Master Degree or Equivalent Certificate and Mark sheet. B.Ed. Degree or Equivalent certificate and Mark sheet. Certificate of Computer Knowledge. Experience certificate. Id proof/Address Proof. Any other.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The Principal reserves the right to cancel part or whole of the engagement notice without assigning any reason. Copies of the notice were sent to the school notice board, the Block Education Officer, Kosagumuda and the District Education Officer, Nabarangpur.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Guest Faculty at Govt HSS Majhidhanua?
faq.answer: The application should reach the Principal, Govt. Higher Secondary School, Majhidhanua on or before 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Which subjects are covered?
faq.answer: Guest Faculty are sought for Odia, English, History, Political Science, Economics and Odia (Optional) in the +2 Arts Stream.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: A Master Degree in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks or equivalent grade and B.Ed. or equivalent degree recognized by the NCTE New Delhi, in case of B.Ed. subject.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Retired Teachers of Govt. and Aided College/HSS must be below 65 years of age.

faq.question: Q5. How much will Guest Faculty be paid?
faq.answer: Rs 400/- per class of 45 minutes, subject to a ceiling of maximum 50 classes with Rs. 20,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How will Guest Faculty be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is made through career assessment, teaching experience and basic experience in computer application, with document verification on 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely temporary and continues till closure of schools on summer vacation in 2027 or posting of PGT in the school, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q8. Will TA/DA be given for document verification?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA shall be admissible for document verification on 12 November 2026.
